entry.title: Trim: Fee Level Matters More Than Skew in Lightning Routing. Lightning routing nodes lend their channel balance for a posted fee.
entry.summary:
Lightning routing nodes lend their channel balance for a posted fee. Operators' tools move that fee with the balance around a hand-set level, and which part of the fee drives revenue is unclear. We present Trim, which models a channel as a two-sided inventory with costly refills.
